pending_commit.commit_message: CHROMIUM: Implement watcher for BluezLevel Debug property This is a handler which is triggered every time the Debug.BluezLevel property is updated. This will toggle whether to enable/disable debug "verbose" logs on bluez component. BUG=chromium:734152 TEST=Do these. 1) Call D-bus set debug level endpoint and enable bluez debug. dbus-send --system --print-reply --dest=org.chromium.Bluetooth \ /org/chromium/Bluetooth org.chromium.Bluetooth.Debug.SetLevels \ byte:<dispatcher verbosity, just set to 0> \ byte:<newblue verbosity, just set to 0> \ byte:<bluez verbosity, set 0 to disable, 1 to enable> \ byte:<kernel verbosity, just set to 0> 2) Verify bluez debug logs are printed to /var/log/messages. Cq-Depend: chromium:1725690 Change-Id: I4b8a070dc33593a0ce305bcb68b8f8ba40e5b9f6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1730376 Tested-by: Archie Pusaka <apusaka@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Archie Pusaka <apusaka@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org>

CHROMIUM: bluez to kernel debug mgmt command This is a handler which is triggered every time the Debug.KernelLevel property is updated, which will send mgmt command to kernel to turn the 'verbose' debugging on or off. BUG=chromium:734152 TEST=Do these. 1) Call D-bus set debug level endpoint and enable kernel debug. dbus-send --system --print-reply --dest=org.chromium.Bluetooth \ /org/chromium/Bluetooth org.chromium.Bluetooth.Debug.SetLevels \ byte:<dispatcher verbosity, just set to 0> \ byte:<newblue verbosity, just set to 0> \ byte:<bluez verbosity, just set to 0> \ byte:<kernel verbosity, set 0 to disable, 1 to enable> 2) Verify kernel debug logs are printed to /var/log/messages. Cq-Depend: chromium:1730376,chromium:1697851 Change-Id: I142bb2307aa31e8e72ee86943580dcc25e526be6 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1741592 Tested-by: Archie Pusaka <apusaka@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Archie Pusaka <apusaka@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sonny Sasaka <sonnysasaka@chromium.org>

FROMGIT: firmware: google: check if size is valid when decoding VPD data The VPD implementation from Chromium Vital Product Data project used to parse data from untrusted input without checking if the meta data is invalid or corrupted. For example, the size from decoded content may be negative value, or larger than whole input buffer. Such invalid data may cause buffer overflow. To fix that, the size parameters passed to vpd_decode functions should be changed to unsigned integer (u32) type, and the parsing of entry header should be refactored so every size field is correctly verified before starting to decode. BUG=chromium:967209 TEST=emerge-kukui chromeos-kernel-4_19 Fixes: ad2ac9d5c5e0 ("firmware: Google VPD: import lib_vpd source files") Signed-off-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Cc: stable <stable@vger.kernel.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <linux@roeck-us.net> Reviewed-by: Stephen Boyd <swboyd@chromium.org> Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20190830022402.214442-1-hungte@chromium.org Signed-off-by: Greg Kroah-Hartman <gregkh@linuxfoundation.org> (cherry picked from commit 4b708b7b1a2c09fbdfff6b942ebe3a160213aacd git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/gregkh/char-misc.git char-misc-next) Change-Id: Iebc51abeba143719d0bb55e78e9048aca559c3b8 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1795463 Tested-by: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Hung-Te Lin <hungte@chromium.org> Commit-Ready: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Sean Paul <seanpaul@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Guenter Roeck <groeck@chromium.org>
